recap: Cavaliers beat the Celtics 132–123 in overtime.
Caris LeVert led the Cavaliers with 41 points (12-21 FG, 6-8 3PT), 4 rebounds and 7 assists.
Jaylen Brown led the Celtics with 32 points (11-22 FG, 2-7 3PT), 8 rebounds and 4 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security, second chances. Effective FG% 60.2 to 59.1.
Biggest swing: Donovan Mitchell makes 27-foot three point jump shot (Dean Wade assists) (OT 4:44), +18 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): LeVert, Mitchell, Allen, Wade, Mobley, +20 in 21:59.
Bench points: CLE 15, BOS 27. Points in the paint: 48–54. Second-chance points: 14–9.
